description:
Launcher and scheduler - pin apps, scripts, folders and URLs, and run anything at a set time, on an interval or at startup.

FlowDesk is a unified task launcher and scheduler. Pin apps, scripts, folders, and URLs, organise them into categories, and schedule anything to run at a time or interval — with optional UAC elevation. Import and export your setup as JSON. Everything in one tight interface, nothing in the system tray you didn't ask for.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.

- Same font and text sizes as the other TAPATCH apps, so most text is a little bigger
- New UI size in Settings → Size and window: text, buttons and panels get bigger or smaller together (60–200%). Ctrl + and Ctrl − work too, Ctrl 0 goes back to 100%
- The window opens where you left it, on the same screen and at the same size. Or pick Full screen under When the window opens
- The old UI size and Startup window settings are now the Size and window section; your old UI size carries over
license_or_tos: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
